thunc 0.7.0 makes **recordings survive a thunc upgrade**. A recording is now named by what your code says about a call, not by the text thunc sends the model, so a later release that rewords thunc's prompts keeps your recordings, and CI, working. Recordings made with 0.4 to 0.6 still replay. A program written for 0.6 runs unchanged.

```bash
pip install --upgrade thunc
```

**What changed** ([how recordings are matched](https://eltarras.github.io/thunc/docs/caching.html#matching))
- **Before:** a recording's name was a hash of the text sent to the model, which includes thunc's own system prompt and its wording of the return type. A release that reworded either would have left every recording unmatched, and CI would fail with "No recorded answer".
- **Calls** are now matched on what your code wrote: the function, instructions, inputs, return type and `system=`.
- **Agent runs** are matched on the same, plus the agent, task and tools. A built-in tool added in a later release doesn't count, so new tools don't rename recordings.
- **Inputs** are turned into JSON values by a fixed function of their own, with sets sorted. Changing how thunc shows inputs to the model won't rename recordings, and a set input now gets the same name on every run; before, its varying order changed the name.

**Your existing recordings** ([the promise](https://eltarras.github.io/thunc/docs/api.html#recordings))
- Recordings made with 0.4 to 0.6 are still found under their old names, so nothing needs re-recording.
- `THUNC_RECORD=missing` leaves them as they are. `THUNC_RECORD=1` records them again under their new names and removes the old files.
- A test pins the names of a set of calls and agent runs in both formats, so a change that would lose recordings fails before it ships.

**Tested**
- Offline tests on Python 3.10–3.14 on Ubuntu and on Windows, also run on macOS, and the Temporal integration tests. New tests cover:
  - Both name formats, pinned. The 0.6 names were computed with 0.6's code.
  - A reworded system prompt and type description still replaying.
  - Calls and agent runs recorded the 0.6 way still replaying.
  - Re-recording moving a recording to its new name.
  - New built-in tools leaving run names alone.

**Behavior changes**
- Answers recorded from now on are saved under new file names. A recordings folder written by 0.7 replays under 0.7 and later. Under 0.6 it doesn't replay, so upgrade thunc wherever those recordings are replayed, CI included.
- Re-recording with `THUNC_RECORD=1` deletes each recording's 0.6-named file once its new one is saved.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eltarras/thunc/compare/v0.6.0...v0.7.0
